title: You got last time
setting: A casual lunch a few days later. Maya reaches for the check before Chris can.

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: Yes. You got last time. And the time before, kind of.
lines.spoken: Yes. You got last time. And the time before, kinda.

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: Yes. You did. The noodles place? And then you got the cab, too, remember?
lines.spoken: Yes. You did. The noodles place? And then you got the cab, too, remember?

lines.speaker: chris
lines.text: Oh. Right. Okay, but this is like, a twelve-dollar lunch.
lines.spoken: Oh. Right. Okay, but this is like, a twelve-dollar lunch.

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: I don't care. I said next one's on me. I'm serious.
lines.spoken: I don't care. I said next one's on me. I'm serious.

lines.speaker: chris
lines.text: You're gonna make this a whole thing.
lines.spoken: You're gonna make this a whole thing.

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: It's not a whole thing. Just... don't make it weird. Let me get it.
lines.spoken: It's not a whole thing. Just... don't make it weird. Lemme get it.

lines.speaker: chris
lines.text: I'm not making it weird. You're making it a little weird.
lines.spoken: I'm not making it weird. You're making it a little weird.

lines.speaker: chris
lines.text: Okay, okay. You got it. Thank you.
lines.spoken: Okay, okay. You got it. Thank you.

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: Thank you. See? That wasn't hard.
lines.spoken: Thank you. See? That wasn't hard.

lines.speaker: chris
lines.text: Mm. You want me to throw in for a coffee after, or is that also a thing?
lines.spoken: Mm. You want me to throw in for a coffee after, or is that also a thing?

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: Oh my god. You can get the coffee.
lines.spoken: Oh my god. You can get the coffee.

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: No, get the coffee. I used all my cash energy on this.
lines.spoken: No, get the coffee. I used all my cash energy on this.

gist.askEn: What are they arguing about, lightly?

gist.askZh: Maya 为什么坚持这次她来？
gist.askEn: Why does Maya insist on paying?

details.askZh: Chris 一开始觉得这顿饭贵不贵？
details.askEn: What does Chris say about the price?

glue.noteZh: going to 缩成 gonna，You're gonna make 五个节拍会并成一条，going 几乎听不见。
don't 里的 t 常常被吃掉，make it 又连在一起，不要听成 don't may kit。
又是 throw in for，for a 弱读，前面刚练过的语块换了个宾语。

chunks.sayAfter: You got last time. I got this.

chunks.meaningZh: 别搞得很别扭 / 别弄得太认真。
chunks.sayAfter: Just let me get it. Don't make it weird.

chunks.form: I said next one's on me.
chunks.meaningZh: 我说过了，下一次我请客。
chunks.sayAfter: I said next one's on me. I'm serious.

roleplay.setupZh: 这是你们的下一顿饭。上次是对方请的，你想兑现承诺把这顿买了。对方还是随手去拿账单。
roleplay.aiRole: Chris, easygoing. He will reach for the check out of habit, joke a little, and give in if you sound firm but warm. He may offer to throw in for coffee.
variants: Chris genuinely forgot he paid last time.
Maya only has a card and the place prefers cash.
They decide Chris can get coffee after.

fluency.promptZh: 讲讲这次午饭是怎么买单的：谁上次请了，谁这次坚持，咖啡又是怎么说的。准备 15 秒，然后说 60、45、30 秒。
fluency.promptEn: Tell how they settled lunch: who paid last time, who insisted today, and what they did about coffee. Prep 15 seconds, then 60, 45, 30.
